public_source_findings.finding: EPA states that in 2016 the easternmost parcel containing the Old and Secure Landfills was segregated and assumed by StarLink Logistics, while Merial retained the western remainder.
public_source_findings.binding_limit: EPA does not identify CRIM ObjectID, current cadastral identifier, Registro finca number, deed number, folio, survey vertices, or plat.

public_source_findings.finding: Barceloneta is within the Manati Registry Section; KARIBE provides public access to property-registry services and certifications.
public_source_findings.binding_limit: KARIBE requires an interactive account/session and applicable fees.

public_source_findings.source: Federal Trade Commission / SEC-hosted company release
public_source_findings.finding: The Sanofi-Boehringer asset swap was contracted in June 2016, cleared in December 2016, and generally closed on January 1, 2017; Merial was the animal-health business acquired by Boehringer.
public_source_findings.binding_limit: Corporate transaction evidence does not establish parcel title.

public_source_findings.source: Dateas mirror of historical OGPE permit data
public_source_findings.finding: Historical permit entries associate cadastral identifier 055-000-002-20 with the Merck site at PR-2 Km 56.7 before the 2016 transaction.
public_source_findings.binding_limit: This is a secondary mirror rather than an authenticated current OGPE or Registro record; it supports lineage but cannot bind current title.
